source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of the Maintenance phase (PDF 10).

blocks.text: Aakhri phase mein lagatar (ongoing) maintenance aur updates hote hain. Is se software theek chalta rehta hai aur users ki zarooraton ya technology mein tabdeeli ke mutabiq dhalta (adapt hota) rehta hai.

blocks.title: Tidbits
blocks.text: Maintenance paude ki dekh bhaal jaisi hai. Paude ko sehatmand aur barhta rakhne ke liye regular taur par paani dena aur us ke masle theek karne parte hain.

blocks.prompt: Software deploy hone ke baad bhi us par kaam kyun karna parta hai?
blocks.explanation: Users ki zarooratein aur technology badalti rehti hain aur naye masle aate hain. Is liye software ko theek chalta rakhne ke liye updates aur fixes chahiye. Yahi maintenance phase hai.

items: Maintenance: aakhri phase; lagatar updates aur fixes ta ke software theek chale aur tabdeeli ke mutabiq dhale (paude ki dekh bhaal ki tarah).
